content: Migration from Electron for a real browser: Tauri 2 cannot preserve Chrome extensions on macOS (WKWebView) and only partial WebView2 browser extensions on Windows; no portable adblock request interception; no per-profile data directory on macOS; no certificate verify/error control parity; no Widevine on WKWebView. Servo 0.1 (2026) is embeddable but experimental, ~62% weighted WPT, no WebExtensions, no render-to-texture; not viable. Only a custom Rust shell embedding CEF (cef-rs 152.x, active, Linux/macOS/Windows x64/arm64) keeps bundled Chromium semantics, but CEF's extension support is partial (small subset of chrome.*; chrome://extensions-support; host must implement extension UI/management) and CEF ~200MB + C++/native packaging. Tauri v3 optional CEF backend was early alpha in May 2026. Electron remains the mature default for browser-like products needing consistent Chromium, CDP, certificate/session control, and extension APIs.
